difference: First arm minus subtract arm within each seed; deltas follow seed_ids order.

notes.private_delivered: Domestic private cargo units delivered, all goods combined.
notes.public_freight_food: Cumulative food spent on public freight as recorded in checkpoints.
notes.public_stock: Closing food, ore and tools in public depots.
notes.unmet: Unmet resident food units; a negative difference means less unmet demand.
